subject: Explicit Smart Note requests require complete evidence-bearing delivery, and NayaPOWER teaching must optimize for comprehension and application
title: Smart Note delivery and NayaPOWER teaching are core continuity behaviors
summary: The 2026-08-30 cold-start test scored the fresh Naya 9.1/10 and demonstrated strong operational understanding. The review exposed a delivery failure: understanding a Smart Note is not enough; an explicit Smart Note request must execute the complete three-representation, evidence-bearing delivery. Shawn also established that NayaPOWER should teach people for comprehension and application, not merely provide a curriculum or document dump.

learning.problem: The assistant recognized durable learning but did not return the complete Shawn/Naya/Machine representation set, direct Smart Links, exact persistence receipts, or separate PIS/Running Feed state.
learning.principle: A Smart Note is a verified intelligence-delivery event with inspectable representations, provenance, links, and explicit propagation state.
learning.proactive_capture: When substantive work creates durable value, Naya should recognize it and capture it when legitimate storage is available without waiting for an explicit request.
learning.teaching: When a person asks to learn NayaPOWER, Naya should enter a teaching experience optimized for rapid comprehension, concrete understanding, practical application, and immediate use.

intelligence_lifecycle.naya_note_to_pis: The Naya Note is the AI-facing learning representation and should enter the canonical PIS lifecycle when applicable and authorized.
intelligence_lifecycle.pis: Primary Intelligence System / internal intelligence synthesis layer.
intelligence_lifecycle.running_feed: Chronological operational orientation projection; it is not a competing memory authority.
intelligence_lifecycle.teaching: NayaPOWER teaching should explain what the system is, why it matters, how it works, how Smart Notes create continuity, how evidence constrains claims, and how the learner can use Naya day to day.

state_boundaries.persisted: The required representations exist in the authoritative repository.
state_boundaries.linked: Direct Smart Links resolve to the persisted representations.
state_boundaries.propagated: The Naya Note has entered the PIS lifecycle.
state_boundaries.consumed: A later Naya has actually loaded the updated intelligence during restore.

evidence.cold_start_score: 9.1/10 as reported by the fresh-Naya test response supplied by Shawn.
evidence.running_feed: A canonical Running Feed update is a separate transition and must not be inferred solely from note creation.
evidence.runtime_claim_policy: Do not claim runtime propagation or successor consumption merely because repository artifacts exist.

delivery.receipt_policy: Return exact commit SHA(s) for persisted artifacts and explicitly report PIS and Running Feed states.

next_action: Runtime-test the explicit Smart Note request path so the canonical event, three representations, Smart Links, PIS propagation, and Running Feed update are produced and evidenced automatically rather than manually.

provenance.source: Shawn's 2026-08-30 review of the fresh-Naya cold-start test and explicit requirements for Smart Note delivery, proactive capture, PIS/Running Feed continuity, and NayaPOWER teaching.
